reviewer: Claude root visual comparison of the pinned dictionary reveals against licensed centerlines on serve.py; not examination-body certification.
scope: The 28 one-stroke-gap characters outside 艹 were viewed stroke by stroke and classified by eye; the 62 艹 characters were spot-checked (茄, 蕨, 荑) and otherwise carry the gap.mjs classification, which is the same D1+D3 → one bar pattern in all 62.

classes.split: The dictionary lifts the pen where the licensed corpus draws one continuous stroke. Same ink, one more pen lift; a stroke-boundary split inside the licensed stroke would reproduce it.
classes.form: The dictionary draws a stroke the licensed corpus does not draw at all (or draws a different component). A split cannot produce it; same ground as the 靑·青 and 戶·戸 holds.
classes.merge: The reverse: the licensed corpus lifts the pen where the dictionary draws one stroke. Two licensed strokes would have to be joined.
